places: Mount Everest (highest peak in Asia and highest point on earth above sea level)

fields.climate: varies from cool summers and severe winters in north to subtropical summers and mild winters in south
fields.terrain: Tarai or flat river plain of the Ganges in south; central hill region with rugged Himalayas in north
fields.hazards: severe thunderstorms; flooding; landslides; drought and famine depending on the timing, intensity, and duration of the summer monsoons
fields.resources: quartz, water, timber, hydropower, scenic beauty, small deposits of lignite, copper, cobalt, iron ore
fields.farm: rice, vegetables, potatoes, sugarcane, maize, wheat, bison milk, milk, mangoes/guavas, bananas
fields.exports: knotted carpets, garments, flat-rolled iron, synthetic fibers, palm oil
fields.industries: tourism, carpets, textiles, small rice, jute, sugar, oilseed mills, cigarettes, cement and brick production
fields.languages: Nepali (official) 44.9%, Maithali 11.1%, Bhojpuri 6.2%, Tharu 5.9%, Tamang 4.9%, Bajjika 3.9%, Avadhi 3%, Nepalbhasha (Newari) 3%, Magar Dhut 2.8%, Doteli 1.7%, Urdu 1.4%, Yakthung/Limbu 1.2%, Gurung…
fields.religions: Hindu 81.2%, Buddhist 8.2%, Muslim 5.1%, Kirat 3.2%, Christian 1.8%; less than 1%: Prakriti, Bon, Jains, Sikh
fields.legal: English common law and Hindu legal concepts
fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; upper age limit varies; no conscription
